summary:
We developed a web platform called AgroSmartCV to help farmers in Cape Verde improve the way they work in agriculture. Our idea is to use NASA environmental data, such as rainfall, temperature, and soil moisture, to help farmers better understand soil conditions and choose the most suitable crops.

This project was created to find solutions to some of the main problems affecting agriculture in Cape Verde, such as water shortages, soil damage, and climate change. By analyzing this information, we aim to help farmers compare different crop options and plan crop rotation more effectively.

Our goal is to bring technology and agriculture closer together, making farming more sustainable, helping farmers use natural resources better, and creating a better future for farmers in Cape Verde.
details:
What is AgroSmart CV and What Is It Used For?

AgroSmart CV is a web platform developed to support and improve agriculture in Cape Verde. Initially, it was designed to cover all 9 inhabited islands of the country and the 7 agroecological zones of Santiago Island, using 15 real agricultural properties as references.

The platform aims to address some of the main challenges faced by Cape Verdean farmers, taking into account different farming methods, such as rain-fed agriculture, drip irrigation, and mixed farming systems.

By using satellite data provided by NASA, such as rainfall, temperature, and soil moisture, AgroSmart CV transforms environmental information into practical recommendations. This helps farmers and agronomists better understand soil conditions, choose more suitable crops, and make decisions that contribute to more efficient agricultural production.

Future Expansion

Although AgroSmart CV was initially developed for Cape Verde, the platform has the potential to reach other countries and regions facing similar agricultural challenges.

The idea is to expand gradually, starting with other semi-arid island regions and eventually reaching Sahel communities and other agricultural areas affected by climate change.

Since the platform uses geographical coordinates and global NASA data, combined with a modular agricultural recommendation system, its features can be adapted to meet the needs of each region.

Programming Languages and Technologies Used

Different technologies were used to develop AgroSmart CV, each serving a specific purpose:

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide Icons, Motion, and jsPDF. These technologies were used to build the platform's interface, organize its content, and provide users with a simple and interactive experience.
  • Backend: Node.js, Express, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and the Google GenAI SDK. These technologies handle data processing, manage communication between the system and users, and integrate artificial intelligence feature
